resources.string: A public link or handle stays the same, thus a party that holds it can watch it over time. A one-time invitation cannot be watched in this way.
A handle proves no person. Check it with the person on a path that you trust before you rely on it.
Each person with the link can send a request, and you accept each one. A reusable link has no first-open lock. Your device ends a timed link when it is online.
The pieces alone restore nothing.
Each contact gets one piece of the social half of your recovery code. You keep the user half.
If you accept, this chat no longer recovers from an earlier break-in.
These digits do not check.
Not sent
Not sent: the relay refused it
Not sent: no route
Not sent: the file did not upload
Not sent: no relay of the group took it
Not sent: the queue of the contact is full
The other person already read the earlier text. An edit changes what their app shows. An edit cannot remove what a person read. You can edit a message for 24 hours.

The members already read the earlier text. A member who left the group, and a member who is offline, keeps the earlier text. UMBRA cannot show that every member sees the same text. You can edit a message for 24 hours.
UMBRA discards the key for the file. The file parts stay at the relay for up to 45 days, and a person who already downloaded the file keeps the file.

This asks the app of the other person to delete the message. The other person can keep a copy. A person who is offline gets the request later. UMBRA cannot delete a message on a device that you do not control.

UMBRA does not tell you whether the request arrived. A relay can hold the request back, and you do not learn that it did.

A message that waits at a relay can reach the other person before your request does. The relay holds an undelivered message for up to 45 days.

The app of the other person keeps a note that you deleted a message here. The other person can remove that note. You cannot.
Revocation acts on the future only. A revoked device keeps the data that it synced.
Anyone in this chat can copy, photograph, or save a message before it disappears.
A message arrives at once. Google learns when each one arrives.
A different party now holds %1$s.
A message did not open, and its sender holds it no more.
Some messages did not arrive.
The clock of this device differs from the network time by more than one hour.
The relay directory is provisional.
one operator

The deletion reached no relay.
This contact has not collected messages for a while.

This deletes the message on the device of each member. You cannot undo this. Each member sees that you removed a message.
A restore from a backup that predates today brings them back.
A removed device took your place in this group. Ask an admin for a new invitation.
The original keeps its metadata, such as a place and a time.
They can still send. Their messages reach this device and are dropped unread.
They are not told.
The file leaves the encrypted store. Each app and service of this device can read it there.
The backup of Android carries no UMBRA data.
